basic_details.job_title: Rajdhani College Delhi Administrative Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Rajdhani College, Raja Garden, New Delhi (University of Delhi) has one permanent Administrative Officer post. The pay is Pay Level 10 (as per the 7th Pay Commission). The single post is reserved for a PwBD candidate with Locomotor Disability (LD). You need a Master's Degree with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade, and the upper age limit is 40 years. You apply online at dunt.uod.ac.in under Advertisement No. RC/RG/152/Non-Teaching/2026/01, dated 17 October 2026. The last date is 21 days after the advertisement is published in the Employment News.

age_limit.details: The upper age limit is 40 years. The notice says age relaxation for reserved categories or others will be as per the rules.

qualification.details: Post Essential Qualification Administrative Officer Master's Degree with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade. | The notice says the post will be filled by direct recruitment through an All India Open Competition, with a written test and an interview.

how_to_apply: Open the online application form at https://dunt.uod.ac.in. The form opens on the date the advertisement is published in the Employment News.
In the form, give your main category (UR/SC/ST/OBC) along with your PwBD claim.
Upload your digitally verifiable Disability Certificate and the document supporting your PwBD reservation claim.
Attach copies of all relevant certificates, degrees and testimonials.
Pay the application fee of Rs. 500/- (for PwBD candidates) online while filling in and submitting the form. The fee is non-refundable.
Submit the form within 21 days of the advertisement's publication in the Employment News.
PwBD candidates who need help with the form may approach the help desk set up at the college. The college will not accept applications by email, fax or offline.
Copies of all relevant certificates, degrees and testimonials
Document supporting the PwBD reservation claim, in the format prescribed by the Union Government and digitally verifiable
Digitally verifiable valid Disability Certificate showing a disability of at least 40 per cent
important_instructions: Applications that are incomplete or arrive after the due date will be summarily rejected. Applications without copies of all relevant certificates, degrees and testimonials will be treated as incomplete. The college reserves the right to change the nature or number of posts, and not to fill any post advertised. Any addendum, corrigendum or information about this recruitment will be given on the college website only.

content_sections.heading: About Rajdhani College
content_sections.text: Rajdhani College is a college of the University of Delhi, located at Raja Garden, New Delhi – 110015. The college is filling this Administrative Officer post by direct recruitment, using the University of Delhi's Scheme of Examination for Assistant Registrar, Assistant Controller of Examination and Administrative Officer (In Colleges).

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The one Administrative Officer post is reserved for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD), Locomotor Disability (LD). No vacancy is shown under UR, OBC, SC, ST or EWS. If you want the PwBD reservation, you must upload a document that supports your claim, as per Govt. of India lists/rules/norms. The certificate must be in the format prescribed by the Union Government and must be digitally verifiable. Your disability must be at least 40 per cent. You must upload a digitally verifiable, valid Disability Certificate as proof with your application. PwBD applicants must state in the application their main category (UR/SC/ST/OBC), which is used for computing the reservation. The notice says the post will be filled by direct recruitment through an All India Open Competition, with a written test and an interview. The upper age limit is 40 years. The notice says age relaxation for reserved categories or others will be as per the rules. If you are already in service, you must apply through proper channel. content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection follows the University of Delhi's two-stage scheme. Stage 1 is a preliminary MCQ test for shortlisting. Stage 2 is a descriptive Examination (Main) followed by an Interview/Personality Test. The final merit list is based only on Stage 2. Meeting the minimum eligibility conditions does not by itself mean you will be called for the written test. Applications will be screened under the University's guidelines to limit the number of candidates. All questions are compulsory. Each question carries 04 marks, and each wrong answer loses 01 mark. The qualifying cut-off is 50% marks of the average score of the top 05% of candidates. For deciding the category cut-off, SC and ST candidates get a relaxation of 05% marks and PwBD candidates get 10%. For one vacant post, 30 candidates are shortlisted for the Examination (Main). All candidates with the same cut-off marks are shortlisted. This test is only for shortlisting and has no weightage in the final assessment. Syllabus in brief: General Studies: General Science, current events of national and international importance, History of India, Indian National Movement, Constitution of India, Indian Polity, Economy and Geography. Reasoning: reasoning, analytical abilities, decision making, data analysis and interpretation. General Mathematical Ability: mathematical calculations, statistical analysis and commercial mathematics of Secondary and Higher Secondary level. Functioning of Higher Educational Institutions: rules and policies on how Higher Educational Institutions in India function, their nodal agencies, their financial and administrative functioning, and the Act, Statutes and Ordinances of the University of Delhi. The Examination (Main) is descriptive, carries 70 marks and lasts 2 hours. It covers three areas: Basic knowledge of the Constitution of India and Indian Polity: evolution, features, amendments, significant provisions and basic structure of the Constitution; Parliament and State Legislatures; the Executive and the Judiciary; Ministries and Departments of the Government; the Acts on Reservation and Transparency; Constitutional posts and bodies; statutory, regulatory and quasi-judicial bodies. Educational Administration and Management: the Higher Education System in India, its Regulatory Bodies and recent developments; Financial Administration in Higher Educational Institutions, including the budget and how it is formulated and executed; use of ICT and other modern technologies in higher education. Functional aspects of working of Government Bodies and Institutions: General Financial Rules; Procurement through GEM; Pension and Grievance handling. In both the Preliminary Test and the Examination (Main), Visually Impaired, Cerebral Palsy and similarly placed PwBD candidates get 20 minutes per hour extra. Both question papers are bilingual (English and Hindi). You may answer in either language, but you must use the same language throughout. The Interview/Personality Test carries 30 marks. It

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Rajdhani College Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 permanent Administrative Officer post, reserved for PwBD candidates with Locomotor Disability (LD).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Rajdhani College Administrative Officer post?
faq.answer: The last date is 21 days from the date the advertisement is published in the Employment News. The notice does not print a calendar date.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Rajdhani College Administrative Officer post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is a Master's Degree with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Rajdhani College Administrative Officer post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 40 years. Age relaxation for reserved categories or others is as per the rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the Rajdhani College Administrative Officer?
faq.answer: The post is at Pay Level – 10, as per the 7th Pay Commission.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for the Rajdhani College Administrative Officer post?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 500/- for PwBD candidates. It is paid online while filling in and submitting the application form, and it is non-refundable.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the Rajdhani College Administrative Officer post?
faq.answer: Apply online at https://dunt.uod.ac.in. Upload your digitally verifiable Disability Certificate and attach copies of your certificates, degrees and testimonials. Applications by email, fax or offline will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Rajdhani College Administrative Officer post?
faq.answer: Selection has three steps: a preliminary MCQ test for shortlisting (400 marks), then a descriptive Examination (Main) (70 marks), then an Interview/Personality Test (30 marks). The final merit is based on the 100 marks of the main exam and the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is there negative marking in the Rajdhani College Administrative Officer preliminary test?
faq.answer: Yes. Each question carries 04 marks, and 01 mark is deducted for each wrong answer.

faq.question: Q10. Is the Rajdhani College Administrative Officer post permanent?
faq.answer: Yes. The advertisement invites applications for a permanent Non-Teaching post of the college, filled by direct recruitment through an All India Open Competition.
